installation.texte: Once installed, it opens from the home screen like an app and works without a network.
installation.geste: Open the browser menu (⋮), then choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen". On iPhone and iPad: the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".

stockage.bloque: The browser is blocking storage: characters cannot be kept on this device. Leave private browsing or allow this site's data, then reopen the app.
apropos.outil: Fabled Lands Helper is a free, unofficial fan tool. It accompanies the printed book without replacing it: it contains no section text, no maps and no illustrations from the books.
apropos.oeuvre: Fabled Lands is a gamebook series by Dave Morris and Jamie Thomson. The French edition is published by Alkonost.
apropos.sources: The adventure sheet labels, the list of codewords and the list of tick-box sections follow the adventure booklet of the French edition, freely downloadable from Alkonost's website. All rights to this material remain with its authors and publisher.
apropos.polices: Typefaces: IM Fell English SC (Igino Marini) and Alegreya (Huerta Tipográfica), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
apropos.donnees: Your characters stay on this device: the app sends nothing over the Internet.
